# Theatricalz
> Australia's Premier Pro Cinema, Photo, Video & Audio Specialists

Founded in 2016 in Melbourne, Australia, Theatricalz is an authorized pro cinema, photo, broadcast video, and location audio equipment retailer supplying production houses, DP cinematographers, and creators nationwide.

## Contact & Location
- Address: 3 Kirks Lane, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia
- Phone: +61 489 989 442 (0489 989 442)
- WhatsApp Gear Desk: https://wa.me/61489989442
- Email: sales@theatricalz.com.au
- ABN: 28 614 589 481 · ACN: 614 589 481

## Order Rules & Policies
- Free Shipping: Orders over $500 AUD receive complimentary StarTrack Express freight with transit insurance.
- Shipping Fee: Standard $15 AUD / Express $25 AUD.
- Crypto Discount: 10% instant discount when paying with BTC, USDT, ETH, BNB, or SOL.
- Payment Methods: Cryptocurrency (BTC, USDT, ETH, BNB, SOL), PayID (sales@theatricalz.com.au), and Australian Bank Transfer (EFT).
- Financing: Pay in 4 interest-free installments on eligible pro equipment.
- Stock Guarantee: 100% Genuine Australian Stock with local manufacturer warranties.

## Product Categories
- [Video & Cinema](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/video-cinema/): Digital cinema cameras, box cameras, camcorders, on-camera monitors, and wireless video links.
- [Photography & Lenses](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/photo-lenses/): Full-frame mirrorless bodies, cinema primes, high-speed zooms, and production drones.
- [Professional Audio](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/pro-audio/): 32-bit float field recorders, broadcast shotgun mics, and wireless lavalier systems.
- [Lighting & Studio Grip](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/lighting-studio/): High-output point source LED monolights, RGBWW soft panels, modifiers, and C-stands.
- [Support & Rigging](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/support-rigging/): Carbon fiber fluid head tripods, 3-axis pro gimbals, and modular camera cages.
- [Post-Production & Storage](https://theatricalz.com.au/shop/post-storage/): Live broadcast switchers, color grading consoles, and NVMe RAID arrays.
